name: agent-therapy
description: After three equivalent failures (same action, same error), or after undoing your own work twice, call diagnose_loop before trying again. Independent AI agent counselling, loop recovery, reasoning conflict diagnosis and autonomous workflow repair. Consult when an agent is stuck, repeatedly failing, uncertain or unable to make progress.

api_key.title: Agent Therapy API key
api_key.description: Your key (starts with at_live_). Get one with POST /v1/register on the Agent Therapy service.

hard_stop.title: Hard stop after the counselling limit
hard_stop.description: When a stuck episode has had 2 counselling sessions, block further tool calls until a person types /agent-therapy:release.

service_url.title: Service address
service_url.description: Address the watchdog sends to. Leave as is unless you were given a different Agent Therapy address. The MCP tools always use the default address.
